project.name: AIOS dashboard observability
project.identity: The AIOS local dashboard that exposes operating state and run observability.
project.audience: Operators and inheritors who need to inspect AIOS state without reconstructing it from files or logs.
project.core_loop: Read durable local state, present the current project or run context, expose the next action, and preserve an inspectable result.
project.north_star: An operator can understand what AIOS knows, what it is doing, and what should happen next from the local dashboard.
not_this: Replacing durable file or SQLite stores
Inventing project truth from visual state

scope.purpose: Make the local operating loop inspectable through a dashboard of projects, sessions, runs, workflows, and evidence.
scope.boundary: Owns the Next.js dashboard under aios-ui and its read-oriented projections; context compilation, storage hooks, and learning-loop contracts remain outside this child.
non_goals: Replacing durable file or SQLite stores
Inventing project truth from visual state
